reviews.title: Please fix it!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Center update on September 29. I am no longer able to mirror playing from my iPad onto my TV via HDMI. I can play the app just fine as long as it’s not plugged into my TV. I can play it from Safari on my TV and it works fine. It’s definitely a problem with the app. I use this almost daily, please fix it quickly!

reviews.title: Good content, bad app
reviews.text: App regularly crashes while casting with iPhone 16 running latest OS and app version. Restarted modem, router, phone and chrome cast and issues continue. Some app updates make it better until another breaks it again.

reviews.title: Purchase Programs
reviews.text: They took away the ability to purchase programs in full which completely ruins the experience for me

reviews.title: Music doesn’t play!
reviews.text:
Great cycling workouts.  Sometime over the summer though, they lost the music. Takes away the whole feel of the workout. 
Personally reached out to them about it. All I get back is autogenerated promotional messages. 
Poor form, BODi.

reviews.title: New set up
reviews.text: I used to like the app and the workouts, but this new layout and the push for these new Bodi workouts aren't my thing. I prefer to look through the programs and find one, not this push for Bodi by random trainers. The organization makes me want to try something new after being with Beachbody for years.

reviews.title: The App Never Stays Up
reviews.text: There have been constant problems with this app. It never stays up and is constantly crashing, workouts constantly never load. They want you spend so much money on a subscription and then more money on their products, it’s not worth it when you aren’t actually paying for any kind of service since you can never use it. Spend your money elsewhere and on a more reliable service.

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: UPDATED TO THEIR RESPONSE: I started the free trial, I loved the original P90x. The billing is outside of the app, so switching back and forth my login didn’t transfer over, so I ended up with both both the P90x and the BODi free trial which then both turned into subscriptions. The p90x is part of BODi, so it makes no sense to have the two separate subscriptions, I see it as BODI being an upgrade (more content) than P90X (which they also agreed was true).  I got charged for both, I tried to fix it, but their support site was down. I assumed they would catch the duplication, that was on me. When another charge for both subscriptions went through, I reached out. They refused to credit me for either subscription. UPDATE: They responded here by stating they ‘proactively’ identified and cancelled my duplicate subscription. They did not, and that was my argument all along - that’s how it should have been. It was a huge fight, with numerous efforts of me reaching out to get an appropriate refund. They were not proactive. Perhaps it is this review that had them reconsider. The platform is great, I loved the original P90X, but unfortunately after the experience with customer service, I moved to a different platform. Which is a shame, because I did wanted to stay. ***Their policy is, once charged, they are not going to refund any money.
